near-far.label: A close target and a distant bystander
near-far.explanation: A Necromancer with Vampire Strike faces a kobold five grids away while a hill giant stands twenty grids away. The closeness scan picks the kobold but leaves its distance variable holding the last entry examined — the giant. The original refuses to cast; the correction judges the chosen kobold and casts.
